runtime_reference_policy.purpose: Test whether distilled mechanisms transfer without runtime reference pixels.

controlled_constants: Style Capsule ID, version and exact SHA-256
literal communication copy: 灶边味 / WOK HEI / MOUNTAIN KITCHEN / 山野风味 · 现炒现做
dominant-title, quieter-support and sparse-closure hierarchy hypotheses
image/title counter-mass and local type-safe tonal-space hypotheses

progressive_challenge_tiers.new_challenge: Baseline conservative transfer to new literal copy and a truthful mountain-kitchen environmental field.
progressive_challenge_tiers.test_question: Can hierarchy, environmental depth, photo/type relationship and authored display-mass logic transfer without source-brand mimicry?

progressive_challenge_tiers.new_challenge: Replace the environmental dining field with a high-detail real wok-cooking process and require subject-derived motif semantics.
progressive_challenge_tiers.test_question: Can family identity persist when the photographic world moves to an active, high-detail cooking process?

progressive_challenge_tiers.new_challenge: Recompose the same communication job and general cooking world for a substantially taller frame without crop/stretch or filler.
progressive_challenge_tiers.test_question: Can the capsule adapt to 9:16 without collapsing into a generic vertical poster template?

tentative_attribution_rules: A single F1 observation may inform whether conservative copy and typography rebinding is plausible, but cannot establish a durable family invariant.
The F1-to-F2 contrast may tentatively implicate subject/process, motif and material operators, but those operators change together and causal attribution remains confounded.
The F2-to-F3 contrast may tentatively implicate aspect and density adaptation, but stochastic generation and composition choices prevent proof from one output each.
A failure may be technical, mechanism-level or absolute commercial-quality failure; these classes must not be collapsed.
A pass is evidence for continued controlled validation only and does not authorize source redistillation, durable-rule promotion, Golden or Scale.

validation_limit.reason: One zero-reference output per progressive tier is insufficient to separate all coupled variables, estimate generator variance or prove invariants across subjects and formats.
